correctness.rationale: Construct e_epsilon orthogonal character projectors and u=sum e_epsilon d_epsilon with unit diagonal; conjugate to diagonal. U normalizer of full diagonal signs trivial, giving q^m maximal cliques. Finite direct multiplication and tuple enumerations corroborated via standalone verify.py.

value.rationale: Determines all simultaneous involution commutation counts and all maximal clique sizes/numbers uniformly for arbitrary finite posets and odd q. The parameter-dependent Potts identity and Tutte recovery are structural bridges between algebraic torsion and graph invariants; these cannot be inferred from a single-involution count alone, and the opposite-fork example shows the exact comparability-graph limitation.
